name: Flame Wave
body:
School evocation [fire]; Level: fire lord 5, magus 5, sorcerer/wizard 5

Components: V,S

Casting Time: 1 standard action

Range: Personal

Area: 25 ft. radius burst around caster

Duration: Instantaneous

Saving Throw: Reflex half; Spell Resistance: yes

This spell causes a sudden burst of fire to emanate from the caster, dealing 1d8 damage for every two caster levels (5d8 at level 10, 6d8 at level 12, 7d8 at level 14, etc., to a maximum of 10d8) to everything within range. The caster is immune.
